title: Welcome to Survivors Hub
text:
Survivors Hub is a free, fan-made app for Azeroth Survivors.

• Add-ons: drop in a zip and it's set up right, then kept up to date from its author's page.
• Runs: every run saved with your build, damage and biggest hits, so you can see what works.
• Builds: turn a good run into a build, publish it to the community, and save the builds other players made.

News and updates about the Hub will show up here.
